rows.text: You open your eyes to find yourself lying in a culture medium of the School of Pure Creation. Two people in IPC uniforms stand outside the glass tank, one looking a bit flashier than the other.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Supervisor, I guarantee you, the 'Humorous Robot' is definitely humorous enough this time." The earnest researcher wipes the sweat from their brow with a handkerchief. "More humorous than me, at least."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "In that case, tell me a joke." The supervisor pats the control panel. "You can understand me, right?"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "What comes in thick and thin, makes people want to dance, and makes them cry? Answer: Electric wires."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I have the best joke up my sleeve. I really want to tell it, but unfortunately, I don't have hands right now... let alone a sleeve."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I have a friend who's a half-borisin. His dad is a borisin, his mom is a borisin... but one time he ran into the Yaoqing, and now he's missing his lower half."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Cut the power supply." The supervisor hurriedly barked orders at the researcher. "Yeah, melt this whole thing down and incinerate the scrap in the red giant star. Just don't let Louis Fleming find out."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
